on Monday announced the launch of PhotonLink, an integrated optics platform.

It gives customers access to both individual components and complete optical assemblies from one partner, helping simplify system design, streamline qualification and reduce the complexity of integrating technologies from multiple suppliers.

The platform brings together Coherent’s broad portfolio of critical photonics technologies, precision assembly and test capabilities to deliver complete optical solutions for next-generation AI datacenters. The platform supports co-packaged optics (CPO), near-packaged optics
and emerging chip to chip connectivity, the company said.

Coherent’s vertical integration spans compound semiconductor materials, lasers, optics, and specialty fiber through final assembly and test. PhotonLink gives customers access to both individual components and complete optical assemblies from one partner, helping simplify system design, streamline qualification and reduce the complexity of integrating technologies from multiple suppliers.

title: Coherent launches PhotonLink platform to supply integrated optics for AI datacenters
